subs.title: Algebra of Vectors and Scalar Product

questions.q: The scalar \(\vec A\cdot\{(\vec B+\vec C)\times(\vec A+\vec B+\vec C)\}\) equals
opts: \([\vec A\vec B\vec C]+[\vec B\vec C\vec C]\)
questions.sol: \((\vec B+\vec C)\times(\vec A+\vec B+\vec C)=(\vec B+\vec C)\times\vec A\), which is perpendicular to \(\vec A\).

questions.q: For non zero vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\), \(|(\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot\vec c|=|\vec a||\vec b||\vec c|\) holds if and only if
opts: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=\vec b\cdot\vec c=\vec c\cdot\vec a=0\)
questions.sol: \(|(\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot\vec c|=|\vec a||\vec b||\vec c|\sin\theta|\cos\phi|\) needs \(\sin\theta=1\) (\(\vec a\perp\vec b\)) and \(\vec c\) parallel to \(\vec a\times\vec b\).

questions.q: The volume of the parallelopiped whose sides are given by \(\vec{OA}=2\hat i-3\hat j\), \(\vec{OB}=\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec{OC}=3\hat i-\hat k\) is
The points with position vectors \(60\hat i+3\hat j\), \(40\hat i-8\hat j\), \(a\hat i-52\hat j\) are collinear if
questions.sol: Equal slopes: \(\dfrac{-11}{-20}=\dfrac{-44}{a-40}\) gives \(a-40=-80\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=a_1\hat i+a_2\hat j+a_3\hat k\), \(\vec b=b_1\hat i+b_2\hat j+b_3\hat k\) and \(\vec c=c_1\hat i+c_2\hat j+c_3\hat k\) be three non-zero vectors such that \(\vec c\) is a unit vector perpendicular to both the vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) and if the angles between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is \(\dfrac\pi6\), then \(\begin{vmatrix}a_1&a_2&a_3\\b_1&b_2&b_3\\c_1&c_2&c_3\end{vmatrix}^2\) is equal to
questions.sol: \([\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]^2=\left(|\vec a\times\vec b|\cdot1\right)^2=|\vec a|^2|\vec b|^2\sin^2\dfrac\pi6\).

questions.q: A vector \(\vec a\) has components \(2p\) and \(1\) with respect to a rectangular cartesian system. This system is rotated through a certain angle about the origin in the counter clockwise sense. If, with respect to the new system, \(\vec a\) has component \(p+1\) and \(1\), then
questions.sol: Rotation keeps the length: \(4p^2+1=(p+1)^2+1\), i.e. \(3p^2-2p-1=0\).

questions.q: The number of unit vectors perpendicular to \(\vec a=(1,1,0)\) and \(\vec b=(0,1,1)\) is
questions.sol: Only \(\pm\dfrac{\vec a\times\vec b}{|\vec a\times\vec b|}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be three non-coplanar vectors and \(\vec p,\vec q,\vec r\) are vectors defined by the relations \(\vec p=\dfrac{\vec b\times\vec c}{[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]}\), \(\vec q=\dfrac{\vec c\times\vec a}{[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]}\), \(\vec r=\dfrac{\vec a\times\vec b}{[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]}\) then the value of the expression \((\vec a+\vec b)\cdot\vec p+(\vec b+\vec c)\cdot\vec q+(\vec c+\vec a)\cdot\vec r\) is equal to
questions.sol: \(\vec a\cdot\vec p=\vec b\cdot\vec q=\vec c\cdot\vec r=1\), while \(\vec b\cdot\vec p=\vec c\cdot\vec q=\vec a\cdot\vec r=0\).

questions.q: Let \(a,b,c\) be distinct non-negative numbers. If the vectors \(a\hat i+a\hat j+c\hat k\), \(\hat i+\hat k\) and \(c\hat i+c\hat j+b\hat k\) lie in a plane, then \(c\) is
questions.sol: \(\begin{vmatrix}a&a&c\\1&0&1\\c&c&b\end{vmatrix}=c^2-ab=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec p\) and \(\vec q\) be the position vectors of \(P\) and \(Q\) respectively, with respect to \(O\) and \(|\vec p|=p\), \(|\vec q|=q\). The points \(R\) and \(S\) divide \(PQ\) internally and externally in the ratio \(2:3\) respectively. If \(OR\) and \(OS\) are perpendiculars then
questions.sol: \(\vec{OR}=\dfrac{3\vec p+2\vec q}5\), \(\vec{OS}=3\vec p-2\vec q\); their dot product \(\dfrac{9p^2-4q^2}5=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\alpha,\beta,\gamma\) be distinct real numbers. The points with position vectors \(\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j+\gamma\hat k\), \(\beta\hat i+\gamma\hat j+\alpha\hat k\), \(\gamma\hat i+\alpha\hat j+\beta\hat k\)
questions.sol: Each side has length \(\sqrt{(\alpha-\beta)^2+(\beta-\gamma)^2+(\gamma-\alpha)^2}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-\hat j\), \(\vec b=\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec c=\hat k-\hat i\). If \(\vec d\) is a unit vector such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec d=0=[\vec b\,\vec c\,\vec d]\), then \(\vec d\) equals
questions.sol: \(\vec b\times\vec c=(1,1,1)\). With \(\vec d=(x,y,z)\): \(x=y\) and \(x+y+z=0\), so \(\vec d\parallel(1,1,-2)\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are non coplanar unit vectors such that \(\vec a\times(\vec b\times\vec c)=\dfrac{(\vec b+\vec c)}{\sqrt2}\), then the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is
questions.sol: \((\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec b-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec c=\dfrac{\vec b+\vec c}{\sqrt2}\) gives \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-\dfrac1{\sqrt2}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec u,\vec v\) and \(\vec w\) be vectors such that \(\vec u+\vec v+\vec w=0\). If \(|\vec u|=3\), \(|\vec v|=4\) and \(|\vec w|=5\), then \(\vec u\cdot\vec v+\vec v\cdot\vec w+\vec w\cdot\vec u\) is
If \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are three non coplanar vectors, then \((\vec a+\vec b+\vec c)\cdot[(\vec a+\vec b)\times(\vec a+\vec c)]\) equals
questions.sol: \((\vec a+\vec b)\times(\vec a+\vec c)=\vec a\times\vec c+\vec b\times\vec a+\vec b\times\vec c\). Dotting with \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c\): \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]+[\vec b\vec a\vec c]+[\vec c\vec b\vec a]=-[\vec a\vec b\vec c]\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec p,\vec q,\vec r\) be three mutually perpendicular vectors of the same magnitude. If a vector \(\vec x\) satisfies the equation \(\vec p\times\left((\vec x-\vec q)\times\vec p\right)+\vec q\times\left((\vec x-\vec r)\times\vec q\right)+\vec r\times\left((\vec x-\vec p)\times\vec r\right)=\vec0\) then \(\vec x\) is given by
questions.sol: With common magnitude \(k\): \(\vec p\times((\vec x-\vec q)\times\vec p)=k^2(\vec x-\vec q)-(\vec p\cdot\vec x)\vec p\), etc. Adding, and using \((\vec p\cdot\vec x)\vec p+(\vec q\cdot\vec x)\vec q+(\vec r\cdot\vec x)\vec r=k^2\vec x\): \(2\vec x=\vec p+\vec q+\vec r\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=4\hat i+3\hat j+4\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i+\alpha\hat j+\beta\hat k\) are linearly dependent vectors and \(|\vec c|=\sqrt3\), then
questions.sol: \(\begin{vmatrix}1&1&1\\4&3&4\\1&\alpha&\beta\end{vmatrix}=1-\beta=0\); then \(1+\alpha^2+1=3\).

questions.q: For three vectors \(\vec u,\vec v,\vec w\) which of the following expression is not equal to any of the remaining three
questions.sol: (a), (b), (d) all equal \([\vec u\,\vec v\,\vec w]\); (c) is \(-[\vec u\,\vec v\,\vec w]\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+\hat j\). If \(\vec c\) is a vector such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=|\vec c|\), \(|\vec c-\vec a|=2\sqrt2\) and the angle between \((\vec a\times\vec b)\) and \(\vec c\) is \(30^\circ\), then \(|(\vec a\times\vec b)\times\vec c|=\)
questions.sol: \(|\vec c|^2-2|\vec c|+9=8\) gives \(|\vec c|=1\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=(2,-2,1)\), of length \(3\). Answer \(3\cdot1\cdot\sin30^\circ\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and a unit vector \(\vec c\) be coplanar. If \(\vec c\) is perpendicular to \(\vec a\), then \(\vec c=\)
questions.sol: \(\vec c=\lambda\vec a+\mu\vec b\) with \(\vec c\cdot\vec a=6\lambda+3\mu=0\): \(\vec c\parallel\vec a-2\vec b=(0,-3,3)\).

questions.q: If the vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) form the sides \(BC,CA\) and \(AB\) respectively of a triangle \(ABC\), then
opts: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a=0\)
\(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec b\times\vec c=\vec c\times\vec a\)
\(\vec a\cdot\vec b=\vec b\cdot\vec c=\vec c\cdot\vec a\)
\(\vec a\times\vec b+\vec b\times\vec c+\vec c\times\vec a=0\)
questions.sol: \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=0\). Crossing with \(\vec a\): \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\times\vec a\); crossing with \(\vec b\): \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec b\times\vec c\).

questions.q: Let the vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) and \(\vec d\) be such that \((\vec a\times\vec b)\times(\vec c\times\vec d)=\vec0\). Let \(P_1\) and \(P_2\) be planes determined by the pair of vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c,\vec d\) respectively, then the angle between \(P_1\) and \(P_2\) is
questions.sol: The normals \(\vec a\times\vec b\) and \(\vec c\times\vec d\) are parallel, so the planes are parallel.

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are unit coplanar vectors, then the scalar triple product \([2\vec a-\vec b\ \ 2\vec b-\vec c\ \ 2\vec c-\vec a]=\)
questions.sol: The three vectors are combinations of coplanar vectors, hence coplanar.

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are unit vectors, then \(|\vec a-\vec b|^2+|\vec b-\vec c|^2+|\vec c-\vec a|^2\) does not exceed
questions.sol: The sum is \(6-2(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a)\) and \(|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2\ge0\) gives \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a\ge-\dfrac32\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i-\hat k\), \(\vec b=x\hat i+\hat j+(1-x)\hat k\) and \(\vec c=y\hat i+x\hat j+(1+x-y)\hat k\), then \([\vec a\ \vec b\ \vec c]\) depends on
questions.sol: \(\begin{vmatrix}1&0&-1\\x&1&1-x\\y&x&1+x-y\end{vmatrix}=(1+x-y-x+x^2)-(x^2-y)=1\).

questions.q: The value of '\(a\)' so that the volume of parallelopiped formed by \(\hat i+a\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat j+a\hat k\) and \(a\hat i+\hat k\) becomes minimum is
questions.sol: \(V=\begin{vmatrix}1&a&1\\0&1&a\\a&0&1\end{vmatrix}=a^3-a+1\); \(\dfrac{dV}{da}=3a^2-1=0\), minimum at \(a=\dfrac1{\sqrt3}\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are two unit vectors such that \(\vec a+2\vec b\) and \(5\vec a-4\vec b\) are perpendicular to each other then the angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is
questions.sol: \((\vec a+2\vec b)\cdot(5\vec a-4\vec b)=5-8+6\,\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec v=2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec w=\hat i+3\hat k\) and \(\vec u\) is a unit vector then the maximum value of \([\vec u\ \vec v\ \vec w]\) is
questions.sol: \([\vec u\,\vec v\,\vec w]=\vec u\cdot(\vec v\times\vec w)\le|\vec v\times\vec w|=|(3,-7,-1)|\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a=(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k)\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=1\) and \(\vec a\times\vec b=\hat j-\hat k\), then \(\vec b\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec b)=(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec a-|\vec a|^2\vec b=\vec a-3\vec b\), and \(\vec a\times(\hat j-\hat k)=(-2,1,1)\). So \(3\vec b=(3,0,0)\).

questions.q: The unit vector which is orthogonal to the vector \(5\hat i+2\hat j+6\hat k\) and is coplanar with the vectors \(2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) is

If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are three non-zero non-coplanar vectors and
\(\vec b_1=\vec b-\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a|^2}\vec a\), \(\vec b_2=\vec b+\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec a|^2}\vec a\)
\(\vec c_1=\vec c-\dfrac{\vec c\cdot\vec a}{|\vec a|^2}\vec a-\dfrac{\vec b\cdot\vec c}{|\vec c|^2}\vec b_1\), \(\vec c_2=\vec c-\dfrac{\vec c\cdot\vec a}{|\vec a|^2}\vec a-\dfrac{\vec b_1\cdot\vec c}{|\vec b_1|^2}\vec b_1\)
\(\vec c_3=\vec c-\dfrac{\vec c\cdot\vec a}{|\vec c|^2}\vec a+\dfrac{\vec b\cdot\vec c}{|\vec c|^2}\vec b_1\), \(\vec c_4=\vec c-\dfrac{\vec c\cdot\vec a}{|\vec c|^2}\vec a-\dfrac{\vec b\cdot\vec c}{|\vec b|^2}\vec b_1\),
then the set of orthogonal vectors is
questions.sol: This is the Gram–Schmidt process: \(\vec b_1\) is \(\vec b\) minus its component along \(\vec a\), and \(\vec c_2\) is \(\vec c\) minus its components along \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b_1\). Check: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b_1=0\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec c_2=0\), \(\vec b_1\cdot\vec c_2=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\). A vector in the plane of \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) whose projection on \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac1{\sqrt3}\), is
questions.sol: \(\lambda\vec a+\mu\vec b=(\lambda+\mu,2\lambda-\mu,\lambda+\mu)\) has equal first and third components — only (a). Its projection on \(\vec c\) is \(\dfrac{4-1-4}{\sqrt3}\), of magnitude \(\dfrac1{\sqrt3}\). (The book misprints option (c) as \(2\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\).)

questions.q: The number of distinct real values of \(\lambda\), for which the vectors \(-\lambda^2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i-\lambda^2\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\hat i+\hat j-\lambda^2\hat k\) are coplanar, is
questions.sol: With \(t=\lambda^2\): \(\begin{vmatrix}-t&1&1\\1&-t&1\\1&1&-t\end{vmatrix}=(2-t)(t+1)^2=0\), so \(\lambda^2=2\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) be unit vectors such that \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=\vec0\). Which one of the following is correct?
opts: \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec b\times\vec c=\vec c\times\vec a=\vec0\)
\(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec b\times\vec c=\vec c\times\vec a\ne\vec0\)
\(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec b\times\vec c=\vec a\times\vec c\ne\vec0\)
\(\vec a\times\vec b,\vec b\times\vec c,\vec c\times\vec a\) are mutually perpendicular.
questions.sol: Crossing \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=0\) with \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) gives the equalities. The unit vectors form an equilateral triangle, so no two are parallel.

questions.q: Let two non-collinear unit vectors \(\hat a\) and \(\hat b\) form an acute angle. A point \(P\) moves so that at any time \(t\) the position vector \(\vec{OP}\) (where \(O\) is the origin) is given by \(\hat a\cos t+\hat b\sin t\). When \(P\) is farthest from origin \(O\), let \(M\) be the length of \(\vec{OP}\) and \(\hat u\) be the unit vector along \(\vec{OP}\). Then,
opts: \(\hat u=\dfrac{\hat a+\hat b}{|\hat a+\hat b|}\) and \(M=(1+\hat a\cdot\hat b)^{1/2}\)
\(\hat u=\dfrac{\hat a-\hat b}{|\hat a-\hat b|}\) and \(M=(1+\hat a\cdot\hat b)^{1/2}\)
\(\hat u=\dfrac{\hat a+\hat b}{|\hat a+\hat b|}\) and \(M=(1+2\hat a\cdot\hat b)^{1/2}\)
\(\hat u=\dfrac{\hat a-\hat b}{|\hat a-\hat b|}\) and \(M=(1+2\hat a\cdot\hat b)^{1/2}\)
questions.sol: \(|\vec{OP}|^2=1+(\hat a\cdot\hat b)\sin2t\), greatest at \(t=\dfrac\pi4\), where \(\vec{OP}=\dfrac{\hat a+\hat b}{\sqrt2}\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) and \(\vec d\) are unit vectors such that \((\vec a\times\vec b)\cdot(\vec c\times\vec d)=1\) and \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=\dfrac12\), then
opts: \(\vec a,\vec d\) are parallel and \(\vec b,\vec c\) are parallel
questions.sol: The product is at most \(1\), so \(\vec a\perp\vec b\), \(\vec c\perp\vec d\) and \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\times\vec d\): all four vectors lie in one plane. \(\vec a,\vec c\) are \(60^\circ\) apart, and \(\vec b,\vec d\) (perpendicular to them in that plane) are \(60^\circ\) or \(120^\circ\) apart.

questions.q: If \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are vectors such that \(|\vec a+\vec b|=\sqrt{29}\) and \(\vec a\times(2\hat i+3\hat j+4\hat k)=(2\hat i+3\hat j+4\hat k)\times\vec b\), then a possible value of \((\vec a+\vec b)\cdot(-7\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k)\) is

Let \(\vec{PR}=3\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) and \(\vec{SQ}=\hat i-3\hat j-4\hat k\) determine diagonals of a parallelogram \(PQRS\) and \(\vec{PT}=\hat i+2\hat j+3\hat k\) be another vector. Then the volume of the parallelepiped determined by the vectors \(\vec{PT}\), \(\vec{PQ}\) and \(\vec{PS}\) is

Let \(O\) be the origin and let \(PQR\) be an arbitrary triangle. The point \(S\) is such that \(\vec{OP}\cdot\vec{OQ}+\vec{OR}\cdot\vec{OS}=\vec{OR}\cdot\vec{OP}+\vec{OQ}\cdot\vec{OS}=\vec{OQ}\cdot\vec{OR}+\vec{OP}\cdot\vec{OS}\). Then the triangle \(PQR\) has \(S\) as its
questions.sol: The first equality rearranges to \((\vec{OP}-\vec{OS})\cdot(\vec{OQ}-\vec{OR})=0\), i.e. \(SP\perp QR\); similarly \(SQ\perp RP\).

questions.q: Let the position vectors of the points \(P,Q,R\) and \(S\) be \(\vec a=\hat i+2\hat j-5\hat k\), \(\vec b=3\hat i+6\hat j+3\hat k\), \(\vec c=\dfrac{17}5\hat i+\dfrac{16}5\hat j+7\hat k\) and \(\vec d=2\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), respectively. Then which of the following statements is true?
opts: The points \(P,Q,R\) and \(S\) are NOT coplanar
\(\dfrac{\vec b+2\vec d}3\) is the position vector of a point which divides \(PR\) internally in the ratio \(5:4\)
\(\dfrac{\vec b+2\vec d}3\) is the position vector of a point which divides \(PR\) externally in the ratio \(5:4\)
The square of the magnitude of the vector \(\vec b\times\vec d\) is \(95\)
questions.sol: \(\dfrac{\vec b+2\vec d}3=\left(\dfrac73,\dfrac83,\dfrac53\right)=\dfrac{5\vec c+4\vec a}9\). So this point lies on both \(QS\) and \(PR\) (the points are coplanar). \(|\vec b\times\vec d|^2=|(3,3,-9)|^2=99\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec c=\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) be three vectors. A vector in the plane of \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) whose projection on \(\vec a\) is of magnitude \(\sqrt{\dfrac23}\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec v=\vec b+\lambda\vec c=(1+\lambda,2+\lambda,-1-2\lambda)\): \(\dfrac{|\vec v\cdot\vec a|}{\sqrt6}=\dfrac{|1+\lambda|}{\sqrt6}=\sqrt{\dfrac23}\) gives \(\lambda=1,-3\).

questions.q: The vector \(\dfrac13(2\hat i-2\hat j+\hat k)\) is
opts: makes an angle \(\dfrac\pi3\) with the vector \((2\hat i-4\hat j+3\hat k)\)
parallel to the vector \(\left(-\hat i+\hat j-\dfrac12\hat k\right)\)
perpendicular to the vector \(3\hat i+2\hat j-2\hat k\)
questions.sol: Length \(\dfrac13\sqrt9=1\). With \((2,-4,3)\): \(\cos\theta=\dfrac{15}{3\sqrt{29}}\ne\dfrac12\). It is \(-\dfrac23\left(-1,1,-\dfrac12\right)\). Dot with \((3,2,-2)\): \(6-4-2=0\).

questions.q: Which of the following expression are meaningful ?
questions.sol: A dot or cross product needs two vectors; in (b) and (d) one factor is the scalar \(\vec u\cdot\vec v\) or \(\vec v\cdot\vec w\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two non-collinear unit vectors. If \(\vec u=\vec a-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec b\) and \(\vec v=\vec a\times\vec b\), then \(|\vec v|\) is
questions.sol: \(|\vec u|^2=1-(\vec a\cdot\vec b)^2=\sin^2\theta=|\vec v|^2\). Also \(\vec u\cdot\vec b=0\), while \(\vec u\cdot\vec a=\sin^2\theta\ne0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec A\) be vector parallel to line of intersection of planes \(P_1\) and \(P_2\). Plane \(P_1\) is parallel to the vectors \(2\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(4\hat j-3\hat k\) and that \(P_2\) is parallel to \(\hat j-\hat k\) and \(3\hat i+3\hat j\), then the angle between vector \(\vec A\) and a given vector \(2\hat i+\hat j-2\hat k\) is
The vector(s) which is/are coplanar with vectors \(\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\), and perpendicular to the vector \(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) is/are
questions.sol: \(\lambda(1,1,2)+\mu(1,2,1)\) dotted with \((1,1,1)\): \(4\lambda+4\mu=0\), so the vector is a multiple of \((0,-1,1)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec x,\vec y\) and \(\vec z\) be three vectors each of magnitude \(\sqrt2\) and the angle between each pair of them is \(\pi/3\). If \(\vec a\) is a non-zero vector perpendicular to \(\vec x\) and \(\vec y\times\vec z\) and \(\vec b\) is non-zero vector perpendicular to \(\vec y\) and \(\vec z\times\vec x\), then
opts: \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-(\vec a\cdot\vec y)(\vec b\cdot\vec z)\)
questions.sol: \(\vec x\cdot\vec y=\vec y\cdot\vec z=\vec z\cdot\vec x=1\). \(\vec a\parallel\vec x\times(\vec y\times\vec z)=\vec y-\vec z\): \(\vec a=\lambda(\vec y-\vec z)\) with \(\vec a\cdot\vec y=\lambda\). Similarly \(\vec b=\mu(\vec z-\vec x)\), \(\mu=\vec b\cdot\vec z\). \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=\lambda\mu(1-1-2+1)=-\lambda\mu\).

questions.q: Let \(\Delta PQR\) be a triangle. Let \(\vec a=\vec{QR}\), \(\vec b=\vec{RP}\) and \(\vec c=\vec{PQ}\). If \(|\vec a|=12\), \(|\vec b|=4\sqrt3\) and \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=24\), then which of the following is (are) true?
questions.sol: \(\vec a+\vec b+\vec c=0\). \(|\vec a|^2=|\vec b+\vec c|^2\): \(144=48+|\vec c|^2+48\), \(|\vec c|^2=48\). \(|\vec c|^2=|\vec a+\vec b|^2\) gives \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-72\). \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\times\vec a\), and \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=144\cdot48-72^2=1728\), so the sum has magnitude \(2\cdot24\sqrt3\).

questions.q: Let \(\hat u=u_1\hat i+u_2\hat j+u_3\hat k\) be a unit vector in \(R^3\) and \(\hat w=\dfrac1{\sqrt6}(\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k)\). Given that there exists a vector \(\vec v\) in \(R^3\) such that \(|\hat u\times\vec v|=1\) and \(\hat w\cdot(\hat u\times\vec v)=1\). Which of the following statement(s) is(are) correct?
opts: There is exactly one choice for such \(\vec v\).
There are infinitely many choices for such \(\vec v\).
If \(\hat u\) lies in the \(xy\)-plane then \(|u_1|=|u_2|\).
If \(\hat u\) lies in the \(xz\)-plane then \(2|u_1|=|u_3|\).
questions.sol: A unit vector having dot product \(1\) with \(\hat w\) is \(\hat w\) itself: \(\hat u\times\vec v=\hat w\). So \(\hat u\perp\hat w\): \(u_1+u_2+2u_3=0\), and \(\vec v\) is fixed only up to adding multiples of \(\hat u\). \(u_3=0\): \(u_1=-u_2\). \(u_2=0\): \(u_1=-2u_3\), i.e. \(|u_1|=2|u_3|\).

questions.q: Three lines \(L_1:\vec r=\lambda\hat i\), \(\lambda\in R\), \(L_2:\vec r=\hat k+\mu\hat j\), \(\mu\in R\) and \(L_3:\vec r=\hat i+\hat j+\nu\hat k\), \(\nu\in R\) are given. For which point(s) \(Q\) on \(L_2\) can we find a point \(P\) on \(L_1\) and a point \(R\) on \(L_3\) so that \(P,Q\) and \(R\) are collinear?
questions.sol: \(P(\lambda,0,0)\), \(Q(0,\mu,1)\), \(R(1,1,\nu)\): \(\dfrac{-\lambda}1=\dfrac\mu{1-\mu}=\dfrac1{\nu-1}\). This is solvable unless \(\mu=1\) or \(\mu=0\).

questions.q: Let \(a\) and \(b\) be positive real numbers. Suppose \(\vec{PQ}=a\hat i+b\hat j\) and \(\vec{PS}=a\hat i-b\hat j\) are adjacent sides of a parallelogram \(PQRS\). Let \(\vec u\) and \(\vec v\) be the projection vectors of \(\vec w=\hat i+\hat j\) along \(\vec{PQ}\) and \(\vec{PS}\), respectively. If \(|\vec u|+|\vec v|=|\vec w|\) and if the area of the parallelogram \(PQRS\) is \(8\), then which of the following statements is/are TRUE?
opts: The length of the diagonal \(PR\) of the parallelogram \(PQRS\) is \(4\)
\(\vec w\) is an angle bisector of the vectors \(\vec{PQ}\) and \(\vec{PS}\)
questions.sol: \(\dfrac{(a+b)+|a-b|}{\sqrt{a^2+b^2}}=\sqrt2\) gives \(2\max(a,b)^2=a^2+b^2\), so \(a=b\). Area \(2ab=8\): \(a=b=2\). \(\vec{PR}=4\hat i\). The bisector of \(\vec{PQ},\vec{PS}\) is along \(\hat i\), not \(\vec w\).

questions.q: Let \(O\) be the origin and \(\vec{OA}=2\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec{OB}=\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\vec{OC}=\dfrac12(\vec{OB}-\lambda\vec{OA})\) for some \(\lambda>0\). If \(|\vec{OB}\times\vec{OC}|=\dfrac92\), then which of the following statements is (are) TRUE?
opts: The acute angle between the diagonals of the parallelogram with adjacent sides \(\vec{OA}\) and \(\vec{OC}\) is \(\dfrac\pi3\)
questions.sol: \(\vec{OA}\perp\vec{OB}\), both of length \(3\): \(|\vec{OA}\times\vec{OB}|=9\), so \(\dfrac\lambda2\cdot9=\dfrac92\), \(\lambda=1\), \(\vec{OC}=\dfrac12(-1,-4,1)\). Projection \(\dfrac{-9/2}3\). Area \(OAB=\dfrac92\). \(\vec{AB}\times\vec{AC}=(6,-3,-6)\): area \(\dfrac92\). Diagonals \(\left(\dfrac32,0,\dfrac32\right)\), \(\left(\dfrac52,4,\dfrac12\right)\): \(\cos\theta=\dfrac1{\sqrt5}\).

questions.q:
Let \(\hat i,\hat j\) and \(\hat k\) be the unit vectors along the three positive coordinate axes. Let
\(\vec a=3\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\), \(\vec b=\hat i+b_2\hat j+b_3\hat k\), \(b_2,b_3\in R\),
\(\vec c=c_1\hat i+c_2\hat j+c_3\hat k\), \(c_1,c_2,c_3\in R\)
be three vectors such that \(b_2b_3>0\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\) and
\(\begin{pmatrix}0&-c_3&c_2\\c_3&0&-c_1\\-c_2&c_1&0\end{pmatrix}\begin{pmatrix}1\\b_2\\b_3\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}3-c_1\\1-c_2\\-1-c_3\end{pmatrix}\)
Then, which of the following is/are true?
questions.sol: The matrix equation says \(\vec c\times\vec b=\vec a-\vec c\). Dot with \(\vec b\): \(\vec b\cdot\vec c=\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\). Dot with \(\vec c\): \(\vec a\cdot\vec c=|\vec c|^2\ne0\) (\(\vec c=0\) would force \(\vec a=0\)). \(b_3=b_2+3\), so \(|\vec b|^2=10+2b_2b_3>10\). Magnitudes: \(|\vec c|^2|\vec b|^2=11-|\vec c|^2\), so \(|\vec c|^2=\dfrac{11}{1+|\vec b|^2}<1\).

questions.q: \(A_1,A_2,\ldots,A_n\) are the vertices of a regular polygon with \(n\) sides and \(O\) is its centre. Show that \(\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n-1}(\vec{OA_i}\times\vec{OA_{i+1}})=(1-n)(\vec{OA_2}\times\vec{OA_1})\).
questions.sol: All \(\vec{OA_i}\) have the same length and consecutive ones enclose the same angle \(\dfrac{2\pi}n\) in the same sense, so every \(\vec{OA_i}\times\vec{OA_{i+1}}\) equals \(\vec{OA_1}\times\vec{OA_2}\). The sum is \((n-1)(\vec{OA_1}\times\vec{OA_2})=(1-n)(\vec{OA_2}\times\vec{OA_1})\).

questions.q: Find all values of \(\lambda\) such that \((x,y,z)\ne(0,0,0)\) and \((\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k)x+(3\hat i-3\hat j+\hat k)y+(-4\hat i+5\hat j)z=\lambda(\hat ix+\hat jy+\hat kz)\) where \(\hat i,\hat j,\hat k\) are unit vectors along the coordinate axes.
questions.sol: Comparing components: \((1-\lambda)x+3y-4z=0\), \(x-(3+\lambda)y+5z=0\), \(3x+y-\lambda z=0\). Non-trivial solution: \(\begin{vmatrix}1-\lambda&3&-4\\1&-3-\lambda&5\\3&1&-\lambda\end{vmatrix}=-\lambda(\lambda+1)^2=0\).

questions.q: If \(C\) is a given non zero scalar and \(\vec A\) and \(\vec B\) be given non zero vectors such that \(\vec A\perp\vec B\), find the vector \(\vec X\) which satisfies the equations \(\vec A\cdot\vec X=C\), \(\vec A\times\vec X=\vec B\)
questions.sol: \(\vec A\times(\vec A\times\vec X)=(\vec A\cdot\vec X)\vec A-|\vec A|^2\vec X\), so \(\vec A\times\vec B=C\vec A-|\vec A|^2\vec X\).

questions.q: A vector \(\vec A\) has components \(A_1,A_2,A_3\) in a right handed rectangular cartesian coordinate system \(OXYZ\). The coordinate system is rotated about the \(z\)-axis through an angle \(\dfrac\pi2\). Find the components of \(A\) in the new coordinate system in terms of \(A_1,A_2,A_3\).
questions.sol: The new \(x\)-axis is the old \(y\)-axis and the new \(y\)-axis is the old negative \(x\)-axis; the \(z\)-axis is unchanged. So the components are \((A_2,-A_1,A_3)\).

questions.q: The position vectors of the points \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) are \(3\hat i-2\hat j-\hat k\), \(2\hat i+3\hat j-4\hat k\), \(-\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(4\hat i+5\hat j+\lambda\hat k\) respectively. If the points \(A,B,C\) and \(D\) lie on a plane, find the value of \(\lambda\).
questions.sol: \([\vec{AB}\ \vec{AC}\ \vec{AD}]=\begin{vmatrix}-1&5&-3\\-4&3&3\\1&7&\lambda+1\end{vmatrix}=17\lambda+146=0\).

questions.q: Let \(OACB\) be a parallelogram with \(O\) at the origin and \(OC\) a diagonal. Let \(D\) be the midpoint of \(OA\). Using vector methods prove that \(BD\) and \(CO\) intersect in the same ratio.
questions.sol: \(\vec{OC}=\vec a+\vec b\), \(\vec{OD}=\dfrac{\vec a}2\). A point of \(CO\): \(t(\vec a+\vec b)\); of \(BD\): \(\vec b+s\left(\dfrac{\vec a}2-\vec b\right)\). Equal when \(t=\dfrac s2=1-s\): \(s=\dfrac23\), \(t=\dfrac13\). So the common point divides both \(BD\) and \(CO\) in the ratio \(2:1\).

questions.q: If vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\) are coplanars show that \(\begin{vmatrix}\vec a&\vec b&\vec c\\\vec a\cdot\vec a&\vec a\cdot\vec b&\vec a\cdot\vec c\\\vec b\cdot\vec a&\vec b\cdot\vec b&\vec b\cdot\vec c\end{vmatrix}=0\)
questions.sol: There are scalars \(x,y,z\), not all zero, with \(x\vec a+y\vec b+z\vec c=0\). Dotting with \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) gives the same relation for the second and third rows. So \(x C_1+yC_2+zC_3=0\): the columns are dependent and the determinant vanishes.

questions.q: In a triangle \(OAB\), \(E\) is the midpoint of \(BO\) and \(D\) is a point on \(AB\). Such that \(AD:DB=2:1\). If \(OD\) and \(AE\) intersect at \(P\), determine the ratio \(OP:PD\) using vector methods.
questions.sol: \(\vec{OD}=\dfrac{\vec a+2\vec b}3\), \(\vec{OE}=\dfrac{\vec b}2\). \(t\cdot\dfrac{\vec a+2\vec b}3=\vec a+s\left(\dfrac{\vec b}2-\vec a\right)\): \(\dfrac t3=1-s\), \(\dfrac{2t}3=\dfrac s2\), so \(t=\dfrac35\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec A=2\hat i+\hat k\), \(\vec B=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec C=4\hat i-3\hat j+7\hat k\). Determine a vector \(\vec R\) satisfying \(\vec R\times\vec B=\vec C\times\vec B\) and \(\vec R\cdot\vec A=0\)
questions.sol: \((\vec R-\vec C)\times\vec B=0\): \(\vec R=\vec C+t\vec B\). \(\vec R\cdot\vec A=15+3t=0\), \(t=-5\).

questions.q: Determine the value of '\(c\)' so that for all real \(x\), the vectors \(cx\hat i-6\hat j-3\hat k\) and \(x\hat i+2\hat j+2cx\hat k\) make an obtuse angle with each other.
questions.sol: Dot product \(cx^2-6cx-12<0\) for all \(x\): either \(c=0\), or \(c<0\) with \(36c^2+48c<0\), i.e. \(-\dfrac43<c<0\).

questions.q: If the vectors \(\vec b,\vec c,\vec d\) are not coplanar then prove that \(\vec a\) is parallel to the vector \((\vec a\times\vec b)\times(\vec c\times\vec d)+(\vec a\times\vec c)\times(\vec d\times\vec b)+(\vec a\times\vec d)\times(\vec b\times\vec c)\)
questions.sol: Using \((\vec u\times\vec v)\times\vec w=(\vec u\cdot\vec w)\vec v-(\vec v\cdot\vec w)\vec u\): the three terms are \([\vec a\vec c\vec d]\vec b-[\vec b\vec c\vec d]\vec a\), \([\vec a\vec d\vec b]\vec c-[\vec c\vec d\vec b]\vec a\) and \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]\vec d-[\vec d\vec b\vec c]\vec a\). Since \([\vec b\vec c\vec d]\vec a=[\vec a\vec c\vec d]\vec b+[\vec a\vec d\vec b]\vec c+[\vec a\vec b\vec c]\vec d\), the sum is \(-2[\vec b\,\vec c\,\vec d]\vec a\).

questions.q: The position vectors of the vertices \(A,B,C\) of a tetrahedron \(ABCD\) are \(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i\) and \(3\hat i\) respectively. The altitude from vertex \(D\) to the opposite face \(ABC\), meets the median line through \(A\) of the \(\Delta ABC\) at \(E\). If the length of the side \(AD\) is \(4\) and the volume of the tetrahedron is \(\dfrac{2\sqrt2}3\) find the position vector of \(E\) for all its possible positions.
questions.sol: \(\vec{AB}\times\vec{AC}=(0,-2,2)\): area of \(ABC=\sqrt2\), so \(\dfrac13\sqrt2\cdot DE=\dfrac{2\sqrt2}3\), \(DE=2\) and \(AE=\sqrt{16-4}=2\sqrt3\). The median from \(A\) goes to \((2,0,0)\), direction \(\dfrac{(1,-1,-1)}{\sqrt3}\): \(E=(1,1,1)\pm(2,-2,-2)\).

questions.q: If \(\vec A,\vec B\) and \(\vec C\) are vectors such that \(|\vec B|=|\vec C|\). Prove that \(\left[(\vec A+\vec B)\times(\vec A+\vec C)\right]\times(\vec B\times\vec C)\cdot(\vec B+\vec C)=0\)
questions.sol: \((\vec A+\vec B)\times(\vec A+\vec C)=\vec A\times\vec C+\vec B\times\vec A+\vec B\times\vec C\). Crossing with \(\vec B\times\vec C\): \((\vec A\times\vec C)\times(\vec B\times\vec C)=[\vec A\vec B\vec C]\vec C\) and \((\vec B\times\vec A)\times(\vec B\times\vec C)=-[\vec A\vec B\vec C]\vec B\). So the vector is \([\vec A\vec B\vec C](\vec C-\vec B)\), and \((\vec C-\vec B)\cdot(\vec C+\vec B)=|\vec C|^2-|\vec B|^2=0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be non coplanar unit vectors, equally inclined to one another at an angle \(\theta\). If \(\vec a\times\vec b+\vec b\times\vec c=p\vec a+q\vec b+r\vec c\), then find scalars \(p,q\) and \(r\) in terms of \(\theta\).
questions.ans: \(p=r=\dfrac{[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]}{1+\cos\theta-2\cos^2\theta}\), \(q=\dfrac{-2\cos\theta\,[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]}{1+\cos\theta-2\cos^2\theta}\); with \([\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=\pm(1-\cos\theta)\sqrt{1+2\cos\theta}\) this is \(p=r=\pm\dfrac1{\sqrt{1+2\cos\theta}}\), \(q=\mp\dfrac{2\cos\theta}{\sqrt{1+2\cos\theta}}\)
questions.sol: Dot with \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\): \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=p+(q+r)\cos\theta\), \(0=q+(p+r)\cos\theta\), \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=r+(p+q)\cos\theta\). So \(p=r\), \(q=-2p\cos\theta\) and \(p(1+\cos\theta-2\cos^2\theta)=[\vec a\vec b\vec c]\). Also \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]^2=\begin{vmatrix}1&\cos\theta&\cos\theta\\\cos\theta&1&\cos\theta\\\cos\theta&\cos\theta&1\end{vmatrix}=(1-\cos\theta)^2(1+2\cos\theta)\).

questions.q: Prove, by vector methods or otherwise, that the point of intersection of the diagonals of a trapezium lies on the line passing through the mid-points of the parallel sides. (you may assume that the trapezium is not a parallelogram)
questions.sol: Take \(A\) as origin, \(\vec{AB}=\vec b\), \(\vec{AD}=\vec d\), \(\vec{AC}=\vec d+t\vec b\) \((t\ne1)\). Diagonals meet where \(s(\vec d+t\vec b)=\vec b+u(\vec d-\vec b)\): \(s=u=\dfrac1{1+t}\), so \(P=\dfrac{\vec d+t\vec b}{1+t}\). Mid points: \(M=\dfrac{\vec b}2\), \(N=\vec d+\dfrac{t\vec b}2\). Then \(\dfrac{tM+N}{1+t}=P\): \(P\) lies on \(MN\).

questions.q:
For any two vectors \(\vec u\) and \(\vec v\), prove that
(i) \((\vec u\cdot\vec v)^2+|\vec u\times\vec v|^2=|\vec u|^2|\vec v|^2\) and
(ii) \((1+|\vec u|^2)(1+|\vec v|^2)=(1-\vec u\cdot\vec v)^2+|\vec u+\vec v+(\vec u\times\vec v)|^2\)
questions.sol: (i) \(|\vec u|^2|\vec v|^2(\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta)\). (ii) \(\vec u\times\vec v\) is perpendicular to \(\vec u+\vec v\), so RHS \(=1-2\vec u\cdot\vec v+(\vec u\cdot\vec v)^2+|\vec u|^2+|\vec v|^2+2\vec u\cdot\vec v+|\vec u\times\vec v|^2=1+|\vec u|^2+|\vec v|^2+|\vec u|^2|\vec v|^2\) by (i).

questions.q: Let \(\vec u\) and \(\vec v\) be unit vectors. If \(\vec w\) is a vector such that \(\vec w+(\vec w\times\vec u)=\vec v\), then prove that \(|(\vec u\times\vec v)\cdot\vec w|\le1/2\) and that the equality holds if and only if \(\vec u\) is perpendicular to \(\vec v\).
questions.sol: Dot with \(\vec u\): \(\vec w\cdot\vec u=\vec u\cdot\vec v\). Cross with \(\vec u\) (on the right): \(\vec w\times\vec u+(\vec w\cdot\vec u)\vec u-\vec w=\vec v\times\vec u\). Putting \(\vec w\times\vec u=\vec v-\vec w\): \(2\vec w=\vec v+(\vec u\cdot\vec v)\vec u+\vec u\times\vec v\). Hence \((\vec u\times\vec v)\cdot\vec w=\dfrac12|\vec u\times\vec v|^2=\dfrac12\sin^2\theta\le\dfrac12\), with equality iff \(\theta=\dfrac\pi2\).

questions.q: Show, by vector methods, that the angular bisectors of a triangle are concurrent and find an expression for the position vector of the point of concurrency in terms of the position vectors of the vertices.
questions.ans: \(\dfrac{a\vec A+b\vec B+c\vec C}{a+b+c}\), where \(a,b,c\) are the lengths of the sides opposite to \(A,B,C\)
questions.sol: The bisector of angle \(A\) meets \(BC\) at \(D\) with \(BD:DC=c:b\): \(\vec D=\dfrac{b\vec B+c\vec C}{b+c}\). The point dividing \(AD\) in the ratio \((b+c):a\) is \(\dfrac{a\vec A+b\vec B+c\vec C}{a+b+c}\). This expression is symmetric, so the same point lies on the other two bisectors.

questions.q: Let \(V\) be the volume of the parallelopiped formed by the vectors \(\vec a=a_1\hat i+a_2\hat j+a_3\hat k\), \(\vec b=b_1\hat i+b_2\hat j+b_3\hat k\), \(\vec c=c_1\hat i+c_2\hat j+c_3\hat k\). If \(a_r,b_r,c_r\) where \(r=1,2,3\) are non-negative real numbers and \(\displaystyle\sum_{r=1}^3(a_r+b_r+c_r)=3L\). Show that \(V\le L^3\).
questions.sol: \(V=|D|\) where \(D\) has three terms with \(+\) sign and three with \(-\) sign, all six being products \(a_ib_jc_k\) that occur among the \(27\) non-negative terms of \((a_1+a_2+a_3)(b_1+b_2+b_3)(c_1+c_2+c_3)\). So \(V\le(\sum a_r)(\sum b_r)(\sum c_r)\le\left(\dfrac{\sum a_r+\sum b_r+\sum c_r}3\right)^3=L^3\) by AM \(\ge\) GM.

questions.q: If \(\vec u,\vec v,\vec w\) are three non-coplanar unit vectors and \(\alpha,\beta,\gamma\) are the angle between \(\vec u\) and \(\vec v\), \(\vec v\) and \(\vec w\), \(\vec w\) and \(\vec u\) respectively and \(\vec x,\vec y,\vec z\) are unit vectors along the bisectors of the angle \(\alpha,\beta,\gamma\) respectively. Prove that \([\vec x\times\vec y\ \ \vec y\times\vec z\ \ \vec z\times\vec x]=\dfrac1{16}[\vec u\ \vec v\ \vec w]^2\sec^2\dfrac\alpha2\sec^2\dfrac\beta2\sec^2\dfrac\gamma2\).
questions.sol: \(\vec x=\dfrac{\vec u+\vec v}{2\cos\frac\alpha2}\), \(\vec y=\dfrac{\vec v+\vec w}{2\cos\frac\beta2}\), \(\vec z=\dfrac{\vec w+\vec u}{2\cos\frac\gamma2}\). \([\vec u+\vec v\ \ \vec v+\vec w\ \ \vec w+\vec u]=2[\vec u\vec v\vec w]\), so \([\vec x\vec y\vec z]=\dfrac{[\vec u\vec v\vec w]}{4\cos\frac\alpha2\cos\frac\beta2\cos\frac\gamma2}\), and \([\vec x\times\vec y\ \ \vec y\times\vec z\ \ \vec z\times\vec x]=[\vec x\vec y\vec z]^2\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c,\vec d\) are distinct vectors satisfying relation \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\times\vec d\) and \(\vec a\times\vec c=\vec b\times\vec d\). Prove that \(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec c\cdot\vec d\ne\vec a\cdot\vec c+\vec b\cdot\vec d\)
questions.sol: Subtracting: \(\vec a\times(\vec b-\vec c)=(\vec c-\vec b)\times\vec d=\vec d\times(\vec b-\vec c)\), so \((\vec a-\vec d)\times(\vec b-\vec c)=0\). The two non-zero vectors \(\vec a-\vec d\) and \(\vec b-\vec c\) are parallel, hence \((\vec a-\vec d)\cdot(\vec b-\vec c)\ne0\), which is the required statement.

questions.q: If \(\hat v\) is the unit vector along the incident ray, \(\hat w\) is the unit vector along the reflected ray and \(\hat a\) is the unit vector along the outward normal to the plane mirror at the point of incidence \(P\). Find \(\hat w\) in terms \(\hat a\) and \(\hat v\).
questions.sol: Reflection keeps the component of \(\hat v\) along the mirror and reverses its component \((\hat a\cdot\hat v)\hat a\) along the normal.

questions.q: Let \(\vec A,\vec B,\vec C\) be unit vectors. Suppose that \(\vec A\cdot\vec B=\vec A\cdot\vec C=0\) and the angle between \(\vec B\) and \(\vec C\) is \(\dfrac\pi6\). Then \(\vec A=\pm2(\vec B\times\vec C)\)
questions.sol: \(\vec A\) is a unit vector along \(\pm(\vec B\times\vec C)\), and \(|\vec B\times\vec C|=\sin\dfrac\pi6=\dfrac12\).

questions.q: If \(\vec X\cdot\vec A=0\), \(\vec X\cdot\vec B=0\), \(\vec X\cdot\vec C=0\) for some non zero vector \(\vec X\), then \([\vec A\,\vec B\,\vec C]=0\).
questions.sol: \(\vec A,\vec B,\vec C\) all lie in the plane perpendicular to \(\vec X\), so they are coplanar.

questions.q: The points with position vectors \(\vec a+\vec b\), \(\vec a-\vec b\), \(\vec a+k\vec b\) are collinear for all real values of \(k\).
questions.sol: All three lie on the line \(\vec r=\vec a+t\vec b\).

questions.q: For any three vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\), \((\vec a-\vec b)\cdot(\vec b-\vec c)\times(\vec c-\vec a)=2\vec a\cdot\vec b\times\vec c\).
questions.sol: \((\vec a-\vec b)+(\vec b-\vec c)+(\vec c-\vec a)=0\): the three vectors are coplanar, so the left side is always \(0\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec A,\vec B,\vec C\) be three vectors of length \(3,4,5\) respectively. Let \(\vec A\) be perpendicular to \(\vec B+\vec C\), \(\vec B\) to \(\vec C+\vec A\) and \(\vec C\) to \(\vec A+\vec B\). Then the length of the vector \(\vec A+\vec B+\vec C=\) ...........
questions.sol: Adding the three conditions: \(\vec A\cdot\vec B+\vec B\cdot\vec C+\vec C\cdot\vec A=0\). So \(|\vec A+\vec B+\vec C|^2=9+16+25\).

questions.q: \(A,B,C,D\) are four points in a plane with position vectors \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c,\vec d\) respectively, such that \((\vec a-\vec d)\cdot(\vec b-\vec c)=(\vec b-\vec d)\cdot(\vec c-\vec a)=0\). The point \(D\) then is the ........... of the triangle \(ABC\).
questions.sol: \(DA\perp BC\) and \(DB\perp CA\): \(D\) lies on two altitudes.

questions.q: If \(\begin{vmatrix}a&a^2&1+a^3\\b&b^2&1+b^3\\c&c^2&1+c^3\end{vmatrix}=0\) and the vectors \((1,a,a^2)\), \((1,b,b^2)\), \((1,c,c^2)\) are non coplanar then the product \(abc=\) ............
questions.sol: Splitting the third column: \((1+abc)\begin{vmatrix}1&a&a^2\\1&b&b^2\\1&c&c^2\end{vmatrix}=0\), and the determinant is non-zero.

questions.q: If \(\vec A,\vec B,\vec C\) are three non coplanar vectors then \(\dfrac{\vec A\cdot(\vec B\times\vec C)}{(\vec C\times\vec A)\cdot\vec B}+\dfrac{\vec B\cdot(\vec A\times\vec C)}{\vec C\cdot(\vec A\times\vec B)}=\) ...........
questions.sol: The first fraction is \(\dfrac{[\vec A\vec B\vec C]}{[\vec A\vec B\vec C]}=1\) and the second \(\dfrac{-[\vec A\vec B\vec C]}{[\vec A\vec B\vec C]}=-1\).

questions.q: If \(\vec A=(1,1,1)\), \(\vec C=(0,1,-1)\) are given vectors then the vector \(\vec B\) satisfying the equations \(\vec A\times\vec B=\vec C\) and \(\vec A\cdot\vec B=3\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec A\times(\vec A\times\vec B)=3\vec A-3\vec B=\vec A\times\vec C=(-2,1,1)\), so \(\vec B=\vec A-\dfrac13(-2,1,1)\).

questions.q:
If the vectors \(a\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\hat i+b\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\hat i+\hat j+c\hat k\) \((a
e b
e c
e1)\) are coplanar then the value of \(\dfrac1{1-a}+\dfrac1{1-b}+\dfrac1{1-c}=\) ...........
questions.sol: With \(x=1-a\), \(y=1-b\), \(z=1-c\) the determinant \(abc-a-b-c+2\) becomes \(xy+yz+zx-xyz=0\); divide by \(xyz\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec b=4\hat i+3\hat j\) and \(\vec c\) be two vectors perpendicular to each other in the \(xy\)-plane. All vectors in the same plane having projections \(1\) and \(2\) along \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) respectively, are given by ...........
questions.ans: \(2\hat i-\hat j\) (taking \(\vec c\) along \(3\hat i-4\hat j\); with the opposite sense, \(-\dfrac25\hat i+\dfrac{11}5\hat j\))
questions.sol: Unit vectors \(\dfrac{(4,3)}5\) and \(\pm\dfrac{(3,-4)}5\). Required vector \(=1\cdot\dfrac{(4,3)}5+2\cdot\dfrac{(3,-4)}5=(2,-1)\).

questions.q: The components of a vector \(\vec a\) along and perpendicular to a non-zero vector \(\vec b\) are ....... and ......... respectively.
questions.ans: \(\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec b|^2}\vec b\) and \(\vec a-\dfrac{\vec a\cdot\vec b}{|\vec b|^2}\vec b\)
questions.sol: The component along \(\vec b\) is \((\vec a\cdot\hat b)\hat b\); the rest of \(\vec a\) is perpendicular to \(\vec b\).

questions.q: Given that \(\vec a=(1,1,1)\), \(\vec c=(0,1,-1)\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=3\) and \(\vec a\times\vec b=\vec c\), then \(\vec b=\) ...........
questions.sol: \(\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec b)=3\vec a-3\vec b=\vec a\times\vec c=(-2,1,1)\).

questions.q: A unit vector coplanar with \(\hat i+\hat j+2\hat k\) and \(\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) and perpendicular to \(\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\) is ...........
A unit vector perpendicular to the plane determined by the points \(P(1,-1,2)\), \(Q(2,0,-1)\) and \(R(0,2,1)\) is ...........

A non zero vector \(\vec a\) is parallel to the line of intersection of the plane determined by the vectors \(\hat i,\hat i+\hat j\) and the plane determined by the vectors \(\hat i-\hat j,\hat i+\hat k\). The angle between \(\vec a\) and the vector \(\hat i-2\hat j+2\hat k\) is .......
questions.sol: Normals: \(\hat k\) and \((1,-1,0)\times(1,0,1)=(-1,-1,1)\). \(\vec a\parallel\hat k\times(-1,-1,1)=(1,-1,0)\); \(\cos\theta=\pm\dfrac{1+2}{\sqrt2\cdot3}\).

questions.q: If \(\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are any two non-collinear unit vectors and \(\vec a\) is any vector, then \((\vec a\cdot\vec b)\vec b+(\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec c+\dfrac{\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)}{|\vec b\times\vec c|}(\vec b\times\vec c)=\) .............
questions.sol: With \(\vec b\perp\vec c\) (as the intended answer assumes), \(\vec b\), \(\vec c\) and \(\vec b\times\vec c\) are three mutually perpendicular unit vectors, and the expression is the sum of the components of \(\vec a\) along them — i.e. \(\vec a\) itself.

questions.q: Let \(\vec{OA}=\vec a\), \(\vec{OB}=10\vec a+2\vec b\) and \(\vec{OC}=\vec b\) where \(O,A\) and \(C\) are non-collinear points. Let \(p\) denote the area of the quadrilateral \(OABC\) and let \(q\) denote the area of the parallelogram with \(OA\) and \(OC\) as adjacent sides. If \(p=kq\) then \(k=\) .............
questions.sol: \(p=\dfrac12|\vec{OB}\times\vec{AC}|=\dfrac12|(10\vec a+2\vec b)\times(\vec b-\vec a)|=\dfrac12\cdot12|\vec a\times\vec b|\) and \(q=|\vec a\times\vec b|\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three vectors having magnitudes \(1\), \(1\) and \(2\) respectively. If \(\vec a\times(\vec a\times\vec c)+\vec b=\vec0\), then the acute angle between \(\vec a\) and \(\vec c\) is .............
questions.sol: \((\vec a\cdot\vec c)\vec a-\vec c=-\vec b\). Squaring: \(-(\vec a\cdot\vec c)^2+4=1\), so \(2\cos\theta=\pm\sqrt3\).

questions.q:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below the lists:
List IList II
(P) Volume of parallelepiped determined by vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(2\). Then the volume of the parallelepiped determined by vectors \(2(\vec a\times\vec b)\), \(3(\vec b\times\vec c)\) and \((\vec c\times\vec a)\) is(1) \(100\)
(Q) Volume of parallelepiped determined by vectors \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) is \(5\). Then the volume of the parallelepiped determined by vectors \(3(\vec a+\vec b)\), \((\vec b+\vec c)\), \(2(\vec c+\vec a)\) is(2) \(30\)
(R) Area of the triangle with adjacent sides determined by vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is \(20\). Then the area of the triangle with adjacent sides determined by vectors \((2\vec a+3\vec b)\) and \((\vec a-\vec b)\) is(3) \(24\)
(S) Area of a parallelogram with adjacent sides determined by vectors \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) is \(30\). Then the area of the parallelogram with adjacent sides determined by vectors \((\vec a+\vec b)\) and \(\vec a\) is(4) \(60\)
questions.sol: (P) \(6[\vec a\vec b\vec c]^2=24\). (Q) \(6\cdot2[\vec a\vec b\vec c]=60\). (R) \((2\vec a+3\vec b)\times(\vec a-\vec b)=-5(\vec a\times\vec b)\): area \(5\times20\). (S) \((\vec a+\vec b)\times\vec a=\vec b\times\vec a\): area \(30\).

questions.q:
Comprehension
Let \(O\) be the origin, and \(\vec{OX},\vec{OY},\vec{OZ}\) be three unit vectors in the directions of the sides \(\vec{QR},\vec{RP},\vec{PQ}\), respectively, of a triangle \(PQR\).
\(|\vec{OX}\times\vec{OY}|=\)
questions.sol: The directions of \(\vec{QR}\) and \(\vec{RP}\) make the angle \(\pi-R\), so the magnitude is \(\sin R=\sin(P+Q)\).

questions.q:
Comprehension
Let \(O\) be the origin, and \(\vec{OX},\vec{OY},\vec{OZ}\) be three unit vectors in the directions of the sides \(\vec{QR},\vec{RP},\vec{PQ}\), respectively, of a triangle \(PQR\).
If the triangle \(PQR\) varies, then the minimum value of \(\cos(P+Q)+\cos(Q+R)+\cos(R+P)\) is
questions.sol: The sum is \(-(\cos P+\cos Q+\cos R)\) and \(\cos P+\cos Q+\cos R\le\dfrac32\) (equality for the equilateral triangle).

questions.q:
Let the vectors \(\vec{PQ},\vec{QR},\vec{RS},\vec{ST},\vec{TU}\) and \(\vec{UP}\) represent the sides of a regular hexagon.
Statement-1 : \(\vec{PQ}\times(\vec{RS}+\vec{ST})\ne\vec0\).
Statement-2 : \(\vec{PQ}\times\vec{RS}=\vec0\) and \(\vec{PQ}\times\vec{ST}\ne\vec0\).
opts: Statement-1 is True, Statement-2 is True; Statement-2 is a correct explanation of Statement-1
Statement-1 is True, Statement-2 is True; Statement-2 is NOT a correct explanation for Statement-1
Statement-1 is True, Statement-2 is False
Statement-1 is False, Statement-2 is True.
questions.sol: \(\vec{ST}=-\vec{PQ}\) (opposite sides), so \(\vec{PQ}\times\vec{ST}=\vec0\), while \(\vec{RS}\) is not parallel to \(\vec{PQ}\): \(\vec{PQ}\times\vec{RS}\ne\vec0\). Hence Statement-2 is false and Statement-1 true.

questions.q: If \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) are vectors in space given by \(\vec a=\dfrac{\hat i-2\hat j}{\sqrt5}\) and \(\vec b=\dfrac{2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k}{\sqrt{14}}\), then the value of \((2\vec a+\vec b)\cdot[(\vec a\times\vec b)\times(\vec a-2\vec b)]\) is
questions.sol: \(\vec a,\vec b\) are perpendicular unit vectors. \((\vec a\times\vec b)\times(\vec a-2\vec b)=(\vec a\cdot(\vec a-2\vec b))\vec b-(\vec b\cdot(\vec a-2\vec b))\vec a=\vec b+2\vec a\). So the value is \(|2\vec a+\vec b|^2=5\).

questions.q: If \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) are unit vectors satisfying \(|\vec a-\vec b|^2+|\vec b-\vec c|^2+|\vec c-\vec a|^2=9\), then \(|2\vec a+5\vec b+5\vec c|\) is
questions.sol: \(6-2(\vec a\cdot\vec b+\vec b\cdot\vec c+\vec c\cdot\vec a)=9\) gives \(|\vec a+\vec b+\vec c|^2=3-3=0\). So \(\vec b+\vec c=-\vec a\) and \(|2\vec a-5\vec a|=3\).

questions.q: Consider the set of eight vectors \(V=\{a\hat i+b\hat j+c\hat k:a,b,c\in\{-1,1\}\}\). Three non-coplanar vectors can be chosen from \(V\) in \(2^p\) ways. Then \(p\) is
questions.sol: \(V\) consists of \(4\) pairs \(\pm\vec v\) (the body diagonals of a cube). Three vectors are non-coplanar exactly when they come from three different pairs: \(\binom43\cdot2^3=32\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a,\vec b\) and \(\vec c\) be three non-coplanar unit vectors such that the angle between every pair of them is \(\pi/3\). If \(\vec a\times\vec b+\vec b\times\vec c=p\vec a+q\vec b+r\vec c\), where \(p,q\) and \(r\) are scalars, then the value of \(\dfrac{p^2+2q^2+r^2}{q^2}\) is
questions.sol: Dot with \(\vec a,\vec b,\vec c\): \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=p+\dfrac{q+r}2\), \(0=q+\dfrac{p+r}2\), \([\vec a\vec b\vec c]=r+\dfrac{p+q}2\). So \(p=r=-q\) and the value is \(1+2+1\).

questions.q: Suppose that \(\vec p,\vec q\) and \(\vec r\) are three non-coplanar vectors in \(R^3\). Let the components of a vector \(\vec s\) along \(\vec p,\vec q\) and \(\vec r\) be \(4\), \(3\) and \(5\) respectively. If the components of this vector \(\vec s\) along \((-\vec p+\vec q+\vec r)\), \((\vec p-\vec q+\vec r)\) and \((-\vec p-\vec q+\vec r)\) are \(x,y\) and \(z\) respectively, then the value of \(2x+y+z\) is

Let \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\) be two unit vectors such that \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=0\). For some \(x,y\in R\), let \(\vec c=x\vec a+y\vec b+(\vec a\times\vec b)\). If \(|\vec c|=2\) and the vector \(\vec c\) is inclined at the same angle \(\alpha\) to both \(\vec a\) and \(\vec b\), then the value of \(8\cos^2\alpha\) is ____ .
questions.sol: \(\vec c\cdot\vec a=x=2\cos\alpha\), \(\vec c\cdot\vec b=y=2\cos\alpha\), and \(x^2+y^2+1=4\): \(8\cos^2\alpha=3\).

questions.q: Consider the cube in the first octant with sides \(OP\), \(OQ\) and \(OR\) of length \(1\), along the \(x\)-axis, \(y\)-axis and \(z\)-axis, respectively, where \(O(0,0,0)\) is the origin. Let \(S\left(\dfrac12,\dfrac12,\dfrac12\right)\) be the centre of the cube and \(T\) be the vertex of the cube opposite to the origin \(O\) such that \(S\) lies on the diagonal \(OT\). If \(\vec p=\vec{SP}\), \(\vec q=\vec{SQ}\), \(\vec r=\vec{SR}\) and \(\vec t=\vec{ST}\), then the value of \(|(\vec p\times\vec q)\times(\vec r\times\vec t)|\) is ____ .
questions.sol: \(\vec p=\dfrac12(1,-1,-1)\), \(\vec q=\dfrac12(-1,1,-1)\), \(\vec r=\dfrac12(-1,-1,1)\), \(\vec t=\dfrac12(1,1,1)\). \(\vec p\times\vec q=\left(\dfrac12,\dfrac12,0\right)\), \(\vec r\times\vec t=\left(-\dfrac12,\dfrac12,0\right)\); their cross product is \(\left(0,0,\dfrac12\right)\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec a=2\hat i+\hat j-\hat k\) and \(\vec b=\hat i+2\hat j+\hat k\) be two vectors. Consider a vector \(\vec c=\alpha\vec a+\beta\vec b\), \(\alpha,\beta\in R\). If the projection of \(\vec c\) on the vector \((\vec a+\vec b)\) is \(3\sqrt2\), then the minimum value of \((\vec c-(\vec a\times\vec b))\cdot\vec c\) equals _____.
questions.sol: \(|\vec a|^2=|\vec b|^2=6\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=3\), \(|\vec a+\vec b|=3\sqrt2\): \(\vec c\cdot(\vec a+\vec b)=9(\alpha+\beta)=18\). The expression is \(|\vec c|^2=6(\alpha^2+\beta^2+\alpha\beta)=6(4-\alpha\beta)\), least when \(\alpha=\beta=1\).

questions.q: In a triangle \(PQR\), let \(\vec a=\vec{QR}\), \(\vec b=\vec{RP}\) and \(\vec c=\vec{PQ}\). If \(|\vec a|=3\), \(|\vec b|=4\) and \(\dfrac{\vec a\cdot(\vec c-\vec b)}{\vec c\cdot(\vec a-\vec b)}=\dfrac{|\vec a|}{|\vec a|+|\vec b|}\), then value of \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2\) is _____.
questions.sol: \(\vec c=-\vec a-\vec b\): numerator \(-9-2\vec a\cdot\vec b\), denominator \(|\vec b|^2-|\vec a|^2=7\). So \(-9-2\vec a\cdot\vec b=3\), \(\vec a\cdot\vec b=-6\) and \(|\vec a\times\vec b|^2=144-36\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec u,\vec v\) and \(\vec w\) be vectors in three-dimensional space, where \(\vec u\) and \(\vec v\) are unit vectors which are not perpendicular to each other and \(\vec u\cdot\vec w=1\), \(\vec v\cdot\vec w=1\), \(\vec w\cdot\vec w=4\). If the volume of the parallelopiped, whose adjacent sides are represented by the vectors \(\vec u,\vec v\) and \(\vec w\), is \(\sqrt2\), then the value of \(|3\vec u+5\vec v|\) is _____.
questions.sol: With \(k=\vec u\cdot\vec v\): \([\vec u\vec v\vec w]^2=\begin{vmatrix}1&k&1\\k&1&1\\1&1&4\end{vmatrix}=2+2k-4k^2=2\), so \(k=\dfrac12\). \(|3\vec u+5\vec v|^2=9+25+30k=49\).

questions.q: Let \(P\) be the plane \(\sqrt3x+2y+3z=16\) and let \(S=\left\{\alpha\hat i+\beta\hat j+\gamma\hat k:\alpha^2+\beta^2+\gamma^2=1\text{ and the distance of }(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)\text{ from the plane }P\text{ is }\dfrac72\right\}\). Let \(\vec u,\vec v\) and \(\vec w\) be three distinct vectors in \(S\) such that \(|\vec u-\vec v|=|\vec v-\vec w|=|\vec w-\vec u|\). Let \(V\) be the volume of the parallelepiped determined by vectors \(\vec u,\vec v\) and \(\vec w\). Then the value of \(\dfrac{80}{\sqrt3}V\) is
questions.sol: \(P\) is at distance \(4\) from the origin, so \(S\) lies in the parallel plane at distance \(\dfrac12\): a circle of radius \(\dfrac{\sqrt3}2\). The equilateral triangle in it has side \(\dfrac32\) and area \(\dfrac{9\sqrt3}{16}\). \(V=6\cdot\dfrac13\cdot\dfrac{9\sqrt3}{16}\cdot\dfrac12=\dfrac{9\sqrt3}{16}\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec{OP}=\dfrac{\alpha-1}\alpha\hat i+\hat j+\hat k\), \(\vec{OQ}=\hat i+\dfrac{\beta-1}\beta\hat j+\hat k\) and \(\vec{OR}=\hat i+\hat j+\dfrac12\hat k\) be three vectors, where \(\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb R-\{0\}\) and \(O\) denotes the origin. If \((\vec{OP}\times\vec{OQ})\cdot\vec{OR}=0\) and the point \((\alpha,\beta,2)\) lies on the plane \(3x+3y-z+l=0\), then the value of \(l\) is ________.
questions.sol: With \(p=\dfrac1\alpha\), \(q=\dfrac1\beta\): \(\begin{vmatrix}1-p&1&1\\1&1-q&1\\1&1&\frac12\end{vmatrix}=\dfrac{p+q+pq}2=0\), i.e. \(\alpha+\beta+1=0\). Then \(3(\alpha+\beta)-2+l=0\) gives \(l=5\).

questions.q: Let \(\vec p=2\hat i+\hat j+3\hat k\) and \(\vec q=\hat i-\hat j+\hat k\). If for some real numbers \(\alpha,\beta\), and \(\gamma\), we have \(15\hat i+10\hat j+6\hat k=\alpha(2\vec p+\vec q)+\beta(\vec p-2\vec q)+\gamma(\vec p\times\vec q)\), then the value of \(\gamma\) is ________.
questions.sol: Dot with \(\vec p\times\vec q=(4,1,-3)\), which is perpendicular to \(\vec p,\vec q\): \(60+10-18=26\gamma\).
